notes.title: 0.5.17 - Singularity Blade Update
notes.content: Added a new power, singularity blade. You can purchase it to be available from the beginning or chest will have it as a spawn option in the Charred Lands. Also implemented other minor gameplay mods and bug fixes.

tags.feature: Added a new power, singularity blade. You can purchase it to be available from the beginning or chest will have it as a spawn option in the Charred Lands.

notes.content: Changed several perimeters in the training level. More enemies spawn (to keep it interesting), they are weakened (to keep player from dying as quickly). Added a video loop to intro movie. Getting a single version that can be exported to all platforms thanks to the advice of Tristan of Victris Games, who has become a great ally and source of input for me. Wanting to hear from more players and change game accordingly.

notes.title: New Training Level Added (Patch 0.5.9)
notes.content: I got some great feedback from a player (who also happens to be a game dev) last week saying that the desert level was too hard in the beginning. I considered lowering the desert difficulty but instead added a much easier training level. As I've said, I'm very interested in player feedback and will often act on it. Enjoy!

tags.feature: added a much easier training level.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.7
notes.content: I know that today was only the first day of Cy's early access on Steam but I found a few minor things I wanted to go ahead and fix. One was some of the text staying on the start screen after resetting and another was making sure all playthroughs are counted on both levels as it affects a few things in game.
